newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch pension fund PGGM posts 15.9 pct 1996 return.
newsitem.headline: Dutch pension fund PGGM posts 15.9 pct 1996 return.

text.p: Dutch health sector pension fund PGGM said on Tuesday it had realised a return of 15.9 percent on its investments in 1996, up from 13.1 percent in the previous year.
The result was mainly due to the high percentage of share investments within its portfolio and the high returns of this sector last year, the second largest Dutch pension fund added.
The total investment portfolio grew to 65.9 billion guilders ($34.5 billion) from 56.9 billion in 1995. Share investments totalled 30.9 billion, sharply up from 22.5 billion in the previous year.
Fixed income investments rose to 27.0 billion from 26.8 billion and property grew to eight billion from 7.6 billion.
The fund's share investments showed a return of 26 percent. It realised fixed income and property returns of 8.4 and 10.1 percent respectively.
PGGM did not give any forecasts for 1997.
